OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page

## Summary

`POST /api/owners` now assigns a server-side `customerCode` formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` — the upper-cased first three letters of `lastName` plus a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current owner count.

**Changes (kept as small, cohesive units to minimize structural impact):**

1. **New function class** `AssignCustomerCode.java` — a fresh single-method class (no surrounding context to hold). It reads the built `Owner` via `@Val`, computes `LAST3` from `lastName`, and derives the sequence from `ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1`, mutating the entity in place so the existing `SaveOwner` persists it.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `customerCode` step between `build` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance as the surrounding steps.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `customerCode` field with a plain getter/setter (each CC 1). MapStruct auto-maps it onto the response DTO by name, exactly as it does for `initials`/`displayName`.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` (readOnly) to the `Owner` response schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it out through `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

5. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** + **`data.sql`** — added the `customer_code` column (the test DB uses `ddl-auto=none`, matching the repo's precedent of only maintaining the hsqldb schema for `registration_date`) and a trailing `NULL` for the seed rows.

The acceptance test's global-sequence check (`cb == ca + 1`) holds because the count is read before this owner is saved, so each successive create sees one more existing owner.
